market.headline: Royal Unibrew A/S Share Buy-back Program Update
market.summary: Royal Unibrew A/S released its latest progress report on its ongoing share buy-back program, detailing transactions conducted between November 16 and November 20, 2026.

market.headline: Técnicas Reunidas to Execute Three Hydrogen-Ready Power Plants for RWE
market.summary: Técnicas Reunidas has been selected to execute the construction of three hydrogen-ready combined-cycle gas power plants for RWE in Germany.

market.headline: Analysts Assess Credit Impact of Webuild's Trevi Acquisition
market.summary: Financial experts from Oddo BHF have evaluated the impact of the Trevi acquisition on Webuild's credit metrics, noting a limited effect on the company's leverage.

market.headline: Thales-Leonardo Joint Venture Secures €240 Million Contract for EU Satellite Altimeters
market.summary: Thales Alenia Space, a joint venture between Leonardo and Thales, has been awarded a contract valued at over €240 million to develop altimeters for European Union satellites.

market.headline: Bilfinger Acquires Danish Specialist CJ Stainless Solution
market.summary: Bilfinger SE has signed an agreement to acquire CJ Stainless Solution, a Danish company specializing in stainless steel manufacturing and industrial services.

market.headline: Evertec Initiated at Market Outperform by Citizens
market.summary: Citizens has initiated coverage on Evertec, Inc. with a 'Market Outperform' rating.

market.summary: Mizuho Securities has lowered its price target for Corning Incorporated from $180 to $145 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

market.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald has increased its price target for Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) from $550 to $575.

market.summary: Investors have consented to the restructuring of a EUR 7 billion Partners Group fund into umbrella vehicles.

market.summary: Alstom has announced a new contract worth approximately €1.2 billion for the modernization, operation, and maintenance of a transport system in Western Europe.

market.summary: Veidekke has been awarded a contract by Øgreid Eiendom to serve as the design and build contractor for the Løvdahlsparken residential project in Stavanger, valued at approximately NOK 164 million.

market.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its price target for Aflac Incorporated, raising it from $125 to $136.

market.summary: Banco Santander has reportedly completed a significant risk transfer transaction involving a portfolio of loans to small and medium-sized Spanish enterprises.

market.headline: CME Group Chairman and CEO Terrence Duffy Sells Company Stock
market.summary: CME Group Chairman and CEO Terrence Duffy has executed a sale of company common stock.

market.headline: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Disclosure in Himalaya Shipping Ltd.
market.summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. has filed a major shareholding notification regarding its interest in Himalaya Shipping Ltd.

market.summary: Beiersdorf Aktiengesellschaft disclosed the acquisition of 337,119 shares between November 16 and November 20, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program.

market.headline: Sandoz Group AG Rating Upgraded to Buy by Deutsche Bank
market.summary: Deutsche Bank has upgraded its rating for Sandoz Group AG from 'Hold' to 'Buy'.

market.summary: ABN AMRO has successfully completed repo trials using Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) as part of a Eurosystem project.

market.headline: EU Regulator Approves Joint Control of Statera Opco by EQT Unit and Ares
market.summary: European regulators have granted approval for an EQT investment unit and Ares Management to exercise joint control over Statera Opco.

market.headline: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Discloses Change in Voting Rights in Carl Zeiss Meditec AG
market.summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. has notified Carl Zeiss Meditec AG of a change in its voting rights, crossing a threshold on November 16, 2026.

market.headline: Volkswagen and Other Automakers Sue New Jersey Over Warranty Repair Law
market.summary: Volkswagen, alongside Ford, Honda, and Stellantis, has filed a lawsuit against New Jersey to challenge a state law concerning warranty and recall repair payments.

market.headline: Volkswagen's Audi Reportedly Facing EUR500 Million Loss at China Plant
market.summary: Volkswagen's subsidiary Audi is reportedly facing a EUR500 million loss at a production site in China.

market.headline: Baird Downgrades Aptiv to Neutral
market.summary: Baird has downgraded Aptiv PLC from Outperform to Neutral, setting a price target of $41.

market.headline: GE Vernova Recognized for Gains in 2026 CPA-Zicklin Index
market.summary: GE Vernova was identified as one of the most improved companies in the 2026 CPA-Zicklin Index regarding political disclosure and accountability.

market.headline: Manulife Investments Announces November 2026 Cash Distributions
market.summary: Manulife Investments has announced the cash distributions for its exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and ETF series of Manulife Funds for November 2026.

market.headline: BNP Paribas Announces Executive Committee Leadership Reshuffle
market.summary: BNP Paribas has announced a series of senior executive appointments and a leadership succession plan, including new roles for risk, audit, and legal functions.

market.headline: Kepler Cheuvreux Raises Price Target for Kongsberg Gruppen
market.summary: Analyst firm Kepler Cheuvreux has increased its price target for Kongsberg Gruppen to 370 NOK from 340 NOK while maintaining a 'hold' rating.

market.headline: Storebrand ASA: Status of Share Buyback Program
market.summary: Storebrand ASA has provided a status update regarding its ongoing share buyback program as of November 23, 2026.

market.headline: Tenaris Executes Dividend Distribution
market.summary: Tenaris is among the companies listed on the Borsa Italiana that distributed a dividend payment on November 23, 2026.

market.summary: Vår Energi ASA has entered into an agreement to acquire ConocoPhillips' Norwegian upstream business and related UK infrastructure for approximately $4.43 billion.

market.headline: Deutsche Bank Lowers Price Target on Ross Stores to $275
market.summary: Deutsche Bank has adjusted its price target for Ross Stores, Inc. from $299 to $275 while maintaining a Buy rating on the stock.

market.headline: JPMorgan Downgrades Nemetschek to Underweight
market.summary: Analyst Joseph George of JPMorgan downgraded Nemetschek SE to 'Underweight' and removed the stock from the bank's 'Analyst Focus List' due to concerns over the company's complex investment narrative.

market.headline: MoffettNathanson Raises Price Target on Spotify Technology to $630 From $524
market.summary: Analyst firm MoffettNathanson has increased its price target for Spotify Technology S.A. while maintaining a neutral rating.

market.headline: Sopra Steria Belgium Joins Cloud Data Engine as Founding Member
market.summary: Sopra Steria Belgium has been announced as a founding member of the Cloud Data Engine, an initiative focused on secure AI data exchange for sensitive industries.

market.summary: Toyota and Waymo are moving forward with plans to test an autonomous Toyota bZ4X fleet in Japan starting in 2027.

market.headline: Goldman Sachs Identifies Market Recovery Catalysts
market.summary: Goldman Sachs outlined three primary catalysts it believes are necessary to signal a bottom in the current stock market correction.

market.summary: Vienna Airport reported the cancellation of all flights to and from Brussels on November 23, 2026, following a nationwide strike in Belgium.

market.headline: Goldman Sachs Updates Memory Chip Industry Outlook
market.summary: Goldman Sachs released a report on the global memory chip industry, lowering earnings forecasts and price targets for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix while maintaining Buy ratings.

market.headline: Snowflake Insider Sells Shares Worth $84.37 Million
market.summary: An insider at Snowflake Inc. sold shares valued at approximately $84.37 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

market.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage on Pinnacle Financial Partners
market.summary: Goldman Sachs has initiated research coverage on Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. with a Buy rating and a price target of $113.

market.headline: Intesa Sanpaolo Downgrades Diasorin to Neutral
market.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has downgraded its rating on Diasorin from buy to neutral while raising the price target from 81.3 to 88.5 euros.

market.headline: Moderna Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences in December 2026
market.summary: Moderna, Inc. has announced it will participate in two upcoming investor conferences in early December 2026.

market.headline: Founder Thomas Straumann Reduces Stake in Straumann Group Below 15 Percent
market.summary: Thomas Straumann, the founder of the Straumann Group, has further reduced his shareholding in the dental implant manufacturer to 14.982 percent.

market.headline: AL Sydbank A/S Share Buyback Programme: Transactions in Week 47
market.summary: AL Sydbank A/S reported its latest share buyback transactions for week 47, continuing its program to reduce share capital.

market.headline: AlphaValue Upgrades Saipem Rating
market.summary: AlphaValue has upgraded its rating on Saipem from 'reduce' to 'add', setting a target price of 4.98 euros.

NVDA.summary: NVIDIA has officially released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2-billion-parameter reasoning model designed for real-time autonomous driving on its DRIVE AGX Thor platform.

ZS.summary: CrowdStrike has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $43.9 billion.

CRWD.headline: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion All-Stock Transaction
CRWD.summary: CrowdStrike has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire cybersecurity firm Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at approximately $43.9 billion.
